77b69b6d39463f63.description: Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services. Job Description Egis MESA is seeking a highly motivated Bridge Engineer, with 5-10 years experience to join our structures team. We are seeking a mid-level engineer who not only excels in technical design but also enjoys contributing to team leadership, client engagement, and cross-disciplinary coordination to improve local communities. ESSENTIAL DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned. Technical Design and Analysis: Completeanalysis and design of various transportation structures including bridges, retaining walls and box culverts ; Use computer-assisted engineering and design software and equipment to prepare engineering and design documents ; Take ownership for projects and lead the preparation of plans, reports and specifications for projects. Client Facing and Team Coordination: Collaborate with internal teams and clients to define project goals and deliverables, ensuring strong communication throughout the design process. Serve as a client liaison, attending meetings, presenting solutions, and building relationships with stakeholders. Work closely with transportation, environmental, and planning teams on multi-disciplinary projects to integrate structural solutions into broader project contexts. Skills: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with a client-first mindset. Proven ability to lead meetings, coordinate with diverse stakeholders, and translate technical concepts into clear, actionable insights. Passion for both the technical success and community impact of a project, from concept through construction. Well established industry (client and colleague) relationships and a willingness to help lead or support proposal efforts.

774c60a1c1368837.description: Job description About the job Operations Supervisor Job Title: Operations Supervisor Department: APC Mining Section: Exploration – Mining & Geotechnical Drilling Reporting To: Operations Manager Job Overview: We are seeking an experienced Operations Supervisor to oversee and coordinate drilling operations in geological and geotechnical projects. The successful candidate will manage drilling crews, ensure operational efficiency, maintain safety standards, and deliver high-quality drilling results according to project requirements. The role requires strong technical knowledge, leadership skills, and the ability to work effectively in remote or challenging environments. Key Responsibilities: Operational Management: Supervise and coordinate daily drilling activities on-site. Plan drilling operations in alignment with project schedules, budgets, and client requirements. Ensure correct rig setup, alignment, and drilling practices for various formations. Monitor drilling performance, penetration rates, and core recovery to optimize efficiency. Troubleshoot technical and operational problems, including stuck rods, fluid loss, and unstable formations. Team Leadership: Lead and manage drilling crews, ensuring clear communication of tasks and responsibilities. Provide on-the-job training and guidance to operators, assistants, and support staff. Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, and safety among crew members. Technical Oversight: Ensure proper use of drilling fluids, downhole tools, and core recovery equipment. Verify the accuracy and completeness of drilling logs, depth records, and daily reports. Inspect equipment regularly and coordinate with maintenance teams for repairs or servicing. Ensure samples are collected, preserved, and documented according to specifications. Reporting and Client Interface: Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and end-of-project reports as required. Communicate regularly with project managers, geologists, and clients regarding progress and challenges. Provide technical input and recommendations to improve drilling performance and safety. Policies, Processes and Procedures: Follow all relevant company policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions. Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, cost reduction, and productivity enhancement. Promote adherence to company policies and operating procedures among team members. Health, Safety and Environment (HSE): Enforce compliance with all HSE policies, procedures, and site regulations. Conduct safety briefings and toolbox talks before operations. Monitor site activities to identify potential hazards and implement corrective actions. Ensure proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) by all crew members. Qualifications and Experience: Minimum 5–7 years of experience in drilling operations, including at least 3 years in a supervisory role. Proven expertise in diamond core drilling and/or rotary drilling techniques. Solid understanding of drilling fluids, downhole tools, and geological formations. Strong knowledge of HSE practices in drilling operations. Proficiency in preparing and reviewing drilling reports. Fluency in English. Education and Certifications: Bachelor's degree in Mining or Geology is an advantage. Required Skills: Strong leadership and decision-making abilities. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Good organizational skills and attention to detail. Strong technical aptitude and problem-solving abilities. Ability to manage drilling crews and coordinate site operations effectively. Commitment to safety, operational efficiency, and teamwork. Reporting Relationship: Operations Manager Supervisory Responsibility: Listed as N/A in the original job description. Working Conditions: High-exposure working environment. High level of physical or mental injury risk. Employment Details for Recruitment: Nationality: Saudi nationals only. Project: Ma'aden-related mining projects across multiple locations in Saudi Arabia, including Taif and the Eastern Province. Contract: One year, with automatic annual renewal. Work Rotation: Two months on-site followed by one month off, subject to confirmation. Working Hours: 12-hour shifts. Joining: ASAP; immediate joiners preferred. Candidates with notice periods of up to two months may be considered. Benefits: Housing allowance and SAR 700 per month for transportation, subject to confirmation. GOSI: Employee contributions deducted according to applicable requirements. Apply now! Preferred candidate Years of experience 2+ years Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

Proven track record of achieving sales targets and developing customer accounts. 7734383362925aa3.description: Job description We are seeking a highly skilled Consultant Dermatologist to join our dynamic team in Medina, Saudi Arabia. 770aa114f12ba793.description: About Assystem Assystem is a leading independent nuclear engineering company with over 60 years of experience in highly regulated sectors. 771dd6c5ec02e704.description: About Lucid Motors Lucid Motors is dedicated to creating advanced mobility experiences through innovation, aiming to drive the world forward. The company's vehicles, built on proprietary technology and software-defined architecture, emphasize a "Compromise Nothing™" approach, integrating performance, sustainability, design, and engineering. The Role: Quality Engineer - Water Leak Lucid Motors is seeking a Quality Engineer - Water Leak to join the team in a full-time capacity. This role is responsible for water leak diagnosis, leak path identification, root cause analysis, and issue reproduction at the AMP2 facility in KSA. The engineer will lead Water Leak Technicians and collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the product lifecycle, focusing on preventing water ingress and sealing-related quality issues through investigation, testing, containment, and corrective actions. The position requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Lead water leak investigation and resolution activities at Lucid AMP2 KSA. Ensure compliance with safety requirements and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) in the work area, maintaining a safe and clean environment according to 6S standards. Execute water leak testing protocols, conducting diagnosis, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis to identify leak paths. Perform water leak tests using approved methods and equipment, including rain booths and water spray systems. Lead root cause analysis and validate corrective actions for field and customer-reported water leak concerns. Document water leak test procedures, findings, and investigation results. Maintain water leak testing equipment, tools, and inspection devices in good working condition. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve vehicle sealing performance and water leak prevention. Ensure strict compliance with Lucid Motors Quality Procedures and standards. Conduct water leak assessments on vehicles and sub-systems during launch and mass production phases. Provide feedback and support manufacturing process improvements related to water leak prevention and sealing quality. Support repair development and validation for water leak issues from launch through mass production. Train quality and production team members on water leak inspection methods, testing procedures, and acceptance criteria. Lead water leak validation activities using environmental chambers, rain test facilities, and vehicle validation tests as required. Required Qualifications and Skills Ability to motivate, influence, and gain consensus, with strong interfacing skills with senior management. Capable of working effectively in a fast-paced environment managing multiple simultaneous projects. Strong data analysis and visualization skills. Ability to lead complex issues and communicate effectively across different organizational levels. Familiarity with Manufacturing Execution System applications is considered a plus. Work Environment This role operates within a challenging and fast-paced environment, requiring close collaboration with Quality Engineering, Manufacturing Quality, Design Engineering, and Repair Teams to ensure vehicle quality, durability, and customer satisfaction.
